Name: Blossom Washed
Desc: This is a 90-hour CULTURE PROCESS washed coffee from the Catuai varietal at our Ratnagiri farm, located at 4,300 feet in the Betamare Patte block. The cherries, with a Brix of 23.2 at harvest, were fermented in stainless-steel fermenters after removing floaters, using a specific strain of yeast and lactic acid bacteria. Following fermentation, they were depulped, washed, and slowly dried on raised beds for 26 days, enhancing their unique flavor profile.

Tasting_Notes: During fermentation, we use yeast in the purpose-built room, carefully monitoring the pH and temperature for several
Desc: Once the ripe cherries are handpicked by our team, we triple wash the fruits to remove any floaters and defective beans from the lot. During fermentation, we use yeast in the purpose-built room, carefully monitoring the pH and temperature for several hours to create a fruity and complex cup. Once fermentation is complete, we sun-dry the cherries on raised beds for 30 days and allow them to rest for 4 weeks before shipment.

Name: Culture Process
Desc: This exceptional coffee undergoes an 80-hour CULTURE PROCESS, sourced from the Catuai varietal at our farm, located 4,400 feet high in the Jeri Patte block. After harvesting with a Brix of 25.8, we placed the cherries in stainless-steel fermenters, adding a specific strain of yeast and lactic acid bacteria. The fermentation took place in a carbon dioxide-rich environment, followed by a slow drying process on raised beds over 29 days with constant stirring. This meticulous approach enhances the unique flavor profile of our coffee.

Name: Dark Room Naturals
Desc: This lot features a unique coffee processing method, starting with thermal shock applied to the cherries to enhance sugar readiness for fermentation. The cherries are then fermented for 48 hours with lactic acid bacteria (LAB) to ensure balanced acidity and optimal flavor development.  After fermentation, they are dried in a dark room for 12 days, minimizing UV degradation and preserving their complexity. The result is a coffee rich in flavor and exceptional quality.

Name: Riverdale Washed
Desc: The coffee cherries which are pulped using clean spring water, effectively removing the mucilage from the seeds. To ensure consistency and uniformity in every batch, the green beans are then immersed in clean water for 24 to 30 hours. After this soaking process, the beans are dried on raised beds for 25 to 30 days. Throughout the drying process, we meticulously inspect and remove any defective beans. The remaining good beans are slow-dried until they reach an optimal moisture level of 11%.
